_about: Components of the compiler (the port map): stage0 files under compiler/src, port files under selfhost/, and the pin of ADR-0113. Edited by scripts/components.py (pin, repin) and by hand (files, ledger).

friction: `const` cannot hold `&str`, so the table of diagnostic codes (185 + 6) is a function that builds a `Vec<Code>` (built on every call). Left as is
Struct fields have no `&'static str`, so `Diag.code` is a `String`. Left as is

The callers could not meet the length premises of `std::json::push_string`·`std::num::push_u64`, so there were three wrapper functions that checked the length at run time (`diag::json_str`·`push_u64`·`push_i64`); they were removed once the premises were dropped (resolved)
The proof cannot follow the character boundary obligation (E0820) of `&s[a..b]` even before and after a one-byte character, so `is_char_boundary` checks it at run time (`diag::push_cell`): left as is

The sort is a hand-written insertion sort over indices, and the range of the indices is checked at run time (`diag::placed`·`to_jsonl`). `std::slice::sort_indices` has a single `Ord` key, so a four-level order would need four passes: left as is
The normal form drops comments. The explanations were moved into the `#[summary]` of the items: left as is
There are no tuples, so `line_col` returns the struct `Pos`: left as is

The ratio of this row is against `diag`·`source` (852 lines of stage0), which have port files. `sha256`·`json` are replaced by `lib/std` (467·945 lines against 82·311 lines) and are not counted in the port lines. The driver `selfhost/main.bmb` grows with every phase, so it enters the port list of C13 at P11

`sha256` (`selfhost/sha256.bmb`): 107 lines of stage0 became 174 lines, 6 definitions. The state and the word schedule are `Vec<u32>` with the length written in the contract (`h.len() == 8`), and the constant `K` is `k(i)`, which reads an array literal inside the function by index (premise `i < 64`). `rotate_right`·`wrapping_add`·bit operations of `u32` are built in and stay as they are. 1 failure on the first run of `bmb verify`: appending a hexadecimal digit as the piece `&s[a..a + 1]` of the text `"0123456789abcdef"` (character boundary E0820, not true for an arbitrary `&str`) was changed to `char::from_u32`

The port carries three things that stage0 got from the Rust standard library: the 128-bit value of integer literals (`wide`, two `u64`s), the exact conversion between decimal text and `f64` (`big`·`float`, reading through big integers and writing the shortest text), and the Unicode character classification tables (`unicode`). All four are counted in the port lines of this row: `lexer` alone is 1,159 lines (1.34 times the 862 lines of stage0)
There are no tuples and no `Result<(char, usize), usize>`, so the result of an escape is the struct `Esc` and the parts of a float are `FloatParts`: left as is

The closures (`sp`, `doc`, `letter`, `digit`) became functions, and `lex_as`, which was one loop, was split into one function per token kind (`continue 'outer` is `return`). That each function moves forward is not proved; the one place that calls them (`past`, and `fwd`, which moves forward by a given length) guarantees it at run time: left as is (an unreachable arm)
`b.get(i + k)` is `at(text, i, k)`: 256 past the end. The overflow obligation of the position arithmetic goes away: left as is
The character boundary obligation (E0820) of `&text[a..b]` is checked at run time by `cut` (the same as `push_cell` of C0): left as is
Structs·enums have no `&'static str`, so `Tok::P` is a `String` (one allocation per punctuation token): left as is; if speed becomes a problem, a punctuation number
`match` was stopped from taking out an owned payload (E0413) and the diagnostic pointed to `match &t.tok`: done as pointed
Within one function one name has one type (E0303): the binding names of `match` arms were made different per arm: left as is

Porting found a code generation defect in stage0: integer elements narrower than 64 bits in a `Vec` field of a struct were read as 8 bytes (a fully proved program printed wrong values). stage0 was fixed and it is pinned by `tests/run/vec_field_narrow`

`ast.bmb` (radixes) and `lib.bmb` (`dump_tokens`) are pieces, so they enter the port lists of C2·C10 in those phases. The standard error the driver prints for a file it cannot read differs from stage0's (the operating system's error text): aligned at P11

The expression traversals of `ast` (`exprs_mut`·`expr_mut`·`block_mut`·`const_exprs_mut`) and the deep copies were ported with the stages before the checker. The type traversals (`types_mut`·`unit_types_mut`·`fn_types`) are ported together with the pieces that use them

There are no struct-form variants (E0233), so a variant like `ExprKind::If { .. }` is a variant holding one struct (`If(If)`, `Call(Call)`): left as is. The field names `requires`·`ensures`·`decreases` are reserved words, so they are `pre`·`post`·`measure`

The measure of recursive descent: stage0's `depth` (nesting limit 256) is passed as the parameter `d`, and the measure is `(256 - d) * 64 + the function's rank`. The property that every recursion cycle of stage0 goes through `enter` became the termination proof as is (43 recursive functions): left as is

Every loop that reads tokens has an upper bound on the number of steps (the number of tokens) as its measure. That one step reads at least one token is not proved (the bound is not reached on inputs where stage0 terminates): left as is, the same choice as `past` of the lexer

The range of the token position (`pos < len`) is a type invariant (`#[invariant(inside)] struct Toks`). The parser's functions read tokens without range contracts: left as is (something that went well)

A reference cannot be returned (E0403), so there is no `peek() -> &Tok`: it was split into functions that ask about the token (`is_p`·`is_kw`·`kind`) and functions that give a copy of the value (`ident`·`literal`). Every place that takes out a branch of the syntax tree needs a `match`: left as is

There are no wildcard arms, so a `match` on `ExprKind` (35 variants)·`TypeKind` (17)·`Tok` (10) always writes all of them. Arms that only return a constant are 201 lines of `parser`, 330 lines of `fmt` and 35 lines of `ast` (9% of the new port lines): left as is, the language's choice (ADR-0026)

The compound assignment `t op= e` needs two trees of the place `t`, so the place is read once more (the diagnostics and length names of the second reading are discarded) (when it was written, user types had no `clone`. Since ADR-0141 it could be written with `.clone()`, but the pinned parser is not reopened for that): left as is

When `&mut self` is called on the right of `&&`·`||` or inside it, the type invariant does not follow afterwards (E0823, a counterexample on the skipped path). `while n > 0 && self.eat_p(..)` was changed so that the condition only asks and the body reads (10 places): workaround, a gap in the prover

A structural measure cannot be used on mutually recursive types that cross structs·enums·`Vec` (`Expr`·`ExprKind`·`Block`·`Stmt`) (E0401). `plain_place`·`type_text` and all of `fmt` take the remaining depth `f`: workaround

Porting found a code generation defect in stage0: the temporary of an `else if` condition was dropped where the whole `if` ended, so a fully proved program died of a double free. stage0 was fixed and `tests/run/else_if_temp` was added
The warnings for input aliases (W0912~W0914) and their fix text do not appear in `dump parse`, so they could not be compared: they are compared when `lint` is ported (after P3)

At first only the part of `fmt` used by `dump parse` was ported (the normal form as written, 1,890 lines). The modes for identity text and qualified text, then `identity`, then the functions of qualified text were ported in later pieces, which closed and pinned this row. `sha256` is recorded in the row of C0 and `check::methodize` in the row of C4
`String` has no `pop`·`truncate`. The two places that fix up a line end (joining `}` and `else`, the `;` of a trait method) take that piece separately, cut it and append it: left as is

There is no `sort_by`, so the name order comes from `std::slice::sort_indices` (the stable sort order of the keys). The run-time check of its length premise was removed once the premise was dropped (resolved). The range of the returned positions is checked where they are used: left as is
`BTreeMap<(u32, u32, u32), String>` (length names) is a `Vec` of structs with a linear search from the back: left as is, only a few per unit

The name modes of the printer: a struct cannot hold a reference, so the `Option<IdMode<'a>>` of `Printer<'a>` (the checker's tables and `&dyn Resolve`) became `Names`, a value owned by the printer: the mode (`Mode`), a copy of the checker's tables, and the table of bound names. The two implementations of `dyn Resolve` (`Collect`, which gathers references, and `Final`, which writes while hashing components) are two modes (`Mode::Collect`·`Mode::Identity`) and the table `refs` holding the text of references: before identity prints a text, it puts the text of the things that text refers to (the edges of the reference graph) into the table. The keys that were gathered through `RefCell` are the printer's `seen`. 36 methods were added and 23 existing places changed. 2 first diagnostics from `bmb check` (E0414, E0303); `bmb verify` passed entirely on the first run (1,451)

`identity` (`selfhost/identity.bmb`): 791 lines of stage0 became 778 lines, 32 definitions. The references that pointed into the syntax (`&'p FnDef` of `Ent<'p>` and so on) are copies (the program is held once more). `Key` (an enum) is a text joining a kind digit and the path: the digits were chosen so that the order of the text is the order of `Key` (0 definition, 1 type, 2 trait). `BTreeMap<Key, _>` is `table::Table`, and `BTreeSet<Key>` is a sorted `Vec<String>`. Tarjan's `while let Some(..) = frames.last_mut()` is a `while` that reads by index with a step limit (`fuel`, `decreases`): termination cannot be shown structurally. `&mut self.pr` and another field of `self` cannot be passed together (E0410), so the printer is kept outside `Ids` and passed as an argument to every method. 9 first diagnostics from `bmb check` (four E0414, four E0303, one E0426: the order of `match` arms); `bmb verify` passed entirely on the first run (1,485). One difference in the first comparison with stage0 (the position key of a definition: the position of `body::DefRow` is the position of the name), 0 after the fix

Qualified text (`selfhost/fmt.bmb`): `qualified_text`·`caller_text`·`qualified_hashes`·`type_hashes`·`trait_hashes`·`trait_impl_address`·`qualify_type` are 14 definitions, 363 lines. Their users (the incremental key, the workspace, `escape`) were not ported yet, so no command printed them: `bmb dump texts` was added to stage0 for the comparison. The qualified printer that was built anew for every definition is built once and reused with the unit and the text swapped (so that the checker's tables are not copied per definition). `fns.values().find(..)`, which finds a function's signature by its position, is a table from positions to `impl` heads. The `&FnDef` that `defs_of` gave cannot be put in a row, so one more walk in the same order (`qual_walk`) was written: the walk order now exists in three places, with `body::defs_of` and `identity::collect` (left as is; they are merged when the incremental key is ported). 0 first diagnostics from `bmb check`, `bmb verify` passed entirely on the first run (1,515), 0 differences in the first comparison with stage0

This row is not closed: it has only the stages before the checker (`refs`·`stdlib`·`closures`·`consts` and the helpers `std_units`·`table`) and compares `dump std`·`dump lower`. `consts::literal_tree` needs the checker's tables and is ported with the checker. The ratio comes out low because the ported part is measured against all of C4. `gate_runs` is the number of `bmb verify` runs so far (added per piece: 3 for the `dump std` piece, 3 for the `dump lower` piece, 2 of which had undecided results)

There is no `&mut dyn FnMut(&mut Expr)` (E0236·E0263): the visitor of a traversal is a struct with an `impl` of a trait (`ast::ExprFn`, `refs::Rewrite`), and the traversal is generic over that type. The values the closure captured become fields of the visitor: left as is

A reference cannot be returned (E0403), so helpers that take out a branch of an expression cannot be written. There are no wildcard arms either, so every function that splits on a visitor and an expression writes all 35 arms of `ExprKind`: 12 places in `closures`, 5 in `consts`, 5 in `ast`, 1 each in `stdlib`·`refs` (24 places × 35 arms, mostly empty arms), and 17 places for `TypeKind` (17 arms): left as is, the language's choice (ADR-0026). By the decision criterion (directive of 2026-11-15) it is a candidate to fix

Matching again on a value bound by an arm is E0410 (the outer value is taken to be used while the `match` borrows it): `match &mut sw.measure { .. }` cannot be written inside an arm, so it was moved out into helper functions that take `Option<Expr>`·`Option<Box<Expr>>` (two per traversal): workaround, the conservatism of the borrow check

User types had no `clone` (E0404). The 86 deep copies of the syntax tree `ast::clone_*` (about 890 lines) were generated mechanically from the type declarations; then, following the decision criterion, `clone` was added to the language (ADR-0141) and they were deleted: `ast.bmb` 1,950 lines → 1,063 lines, 87 definitions and their proofs gone. The investigation found a double free in generic `Vec<T>.clone()`
There is no `include_str!`: the text of the standard library is `selfhost/std_units.bmb` (one string literal per unit), made by `scripts/std_units.py`, and the gate checks its freshness: left as is

There is no way to append a `Vec` whose elements move to the end of another `Vec` (`append`·`extend`): `ast::append<T>`, which moves by reversing twice, was written: workaround, a gap in the standard library

A map whose values are not copied cannot be read (`BTreeMap::get` needs `V: Copy`, ADR-0097). The port's `table::Table<V>` wraps a map from keys to positions in a `Vec`, checks at run time that the position is in range, and hands that out as a contract (`within`): workaround

stage0's `stdlib::named` walks a copy of the program (because the walking function takes `&mut`). The port walks the program itself without copying: the visitor modifies nothing, so the result is the same

There is no `i128`. stage0's constant evaluation computes every integer as `i128`. The port uses sign and magnitude (`consts::Num { neg, mag: u64 }`): the values of every integer type fit there, and a result that does not fit is an overflow in every type, so the diagnostics are the same. Bit operations, shifts and wrapping go through the 64-bit two's complement form (`pattern`·`from_pattern`): left as is; the edge inputs `tests/port/lower/consts-*.txt` compare every operation

There is no `Option<&T>` (references only as arguments, ADR-0015): the evaluator's `want: Option<&TypeKind>` is `&Option<TypeKind>`, and every place that gives the context type puts `Some(..)` in a local variable and passes a reference to it: left as is

Every place in a function returning `Option` that takes out a value and returns if there is none (Rust's `?`) becomes a temporary variable and four lines of `match` (`let mut x = default; match f() { None => { return None; }, Some(v) => { x = v; } }`): 41 places in `consts`. The form with `return` in the value position of an arm does not type-check: workaround. By the decision criterion it is a candidate

A value moved on only one path is E0414: where a value is passed on or discarded depending on a condition, the discarding side writes `let dropped: T = v;` (`consts::keep`, `array_lens`): left as is, the language's choice that drop points are fixed in the text (ADR-0031 §2)

stage0's `closures::lower` tells the expressions inside closures apart by a set of addresses (`*const Expr`). The port gives the traversal a `deep` argument and does not go inside closures: it sees the same expressions in the same order (differential test `lower`). stage0 rewrites a copy of each function and puts them all back at once, while the port rewrites in place: the rewriting of one function does not read another function, so the result is the same

The lowering state that the closures captured (ten tables and two counters) became fields of the visitor struct `closures::State`. `&mut self` and another field of `self` cannot be passed in one call (E0410), so these are free functions taking `st: &mut State` instead of methods: left as is

Passing an element as `&mut` in a loop over a field of a struct makes the proof encoding expensive: `refs::module` took 88M rlimit for five loops (30 seconds from an empty cache), and `ast::mod_types` and `closures::lower`·`plan` hit the limit and were undecided. Moving the loop into a helper that takes `&mut Vec<T>` makes it prove (141M rlimit for the whole port after the split): workaround. The encoding time itself is left as an open task (`closures::round_mod` alone takes 66 seconds, about 55 of them outside the solver)

Where an index could not be shown in range within the limit (a loop that reads `st.generics.items[gi].bounded[b]` while modifying another table of `st`), the reads were first gathered into a local `Vec` and the writes done afterwards (`closures::init_names`·`init_traits`·`targets`): workaround

Porting found two defects in stage0. (1) A repeat count written with a name of the outer unit was read as that of an inner unit that comes later, and a correct program was rejected with E0301: the parser was fixed and the port followed in the same commit, `tests/conformance/02/named_length_before_nested_unit`. Reading the JSON syntax tree (`ast_json.rs`) had the same defect and was fixed together. (2) The diagnostics of constant evaluation wrote `char` with Rust's `Debug` (the escapes follow Rust's table of printable characters): changed to the form the normal form writes

The first pass: 4,076 lines of port (`types` 1,210 + `decls` 2,866) for 2,260 lines of stage0 (what is reached from `collect`), ratio 1.8. In the first build all 912 tracked `.bmb` files were byte-identical, and two of 882 proofs failed (one loop invariant each). 2 full runs of `bmb verify`

Equality of types: stage0's `TypeKind ==` (which ignores positions) is a `match` that splits two values together, and the port has no such form (splitting an arm's binding again is E0410). A distinct text is made for each type (`types::key`) and compared as text: workaround. `overlaps`·`unify`, which walk pairs, have one helper function per arm
A reference cannot be kept in a local variable (`let b: &str = ..`), so the names of bounds are copied into `String`s (7 places): left as is, the language's choice (ADR-0015)

The `match`es on `TypeKind` (17 arms) were written with preprocessing (a script that fills in the arms): the text written has 2~6 arms while the port's text has 17 (42 places in `types`·`decls`). It was decided not to add wildcard arms (the rationale of ADR-0141)
The built-in declarations (28 functions, 5 system types) are made from stage0's `dump decls` (`scripts/builtins.py`): ported by hand, the two tables would drift apart

Where `clone` (ADR-0141) is used: every place that reads a value of a table and then modifies `self` (`self.adts.items[i].generics.clone()` and so on, some 90 places). Not a single copy function was written

Function heads and context: 1,345 lines of port `body.bmb` (normal form) for about 810 lines of stage0 (`check_mod`·`check_fn`·`check_effects`·parameter forms·`check_contract`·`declare`·`check_const`·`expect_ty`·`block`), ratio 1.7. `bmb check` on the first text written gave 63 diagnostics: wildcard arms (E0224) 8, declaration order of arms (E0426) 4, a local variable holding a reference (E0403) 4, `== None` in exec code (E0425) 1, the variable name `spec` (a reserved word, E0103) 1, a value moved on only one path (E0414) 1, the same name with different types in one function (E0303) 1, and the rest were E0304 caused by that one syntax error hiding all the functions after it. 0 on the third `check`. 2 runs of `bmb verify`: one failure among 69 definitions (the invariant of a `for` that starts in the middle of a `Vec` whose length changes on the way, undecided E0811), fixed by looping from the start and comparing the index. The `match`es that write every arm were written with a script that fills in the arms from the enum declaration (`TypeKind` 11 places, `ExprKind` 2, `Stmt` 1). Statements and expressions are empty bodies (`stmt`·`expr`·`measure_type`) that the next piece fills in: until then `body` is not wired into the driver

Statements: 740 lines of port for about 420 lines of stage0 (`stmt`, `loop_clauses`, `struct_fields`, `deref_fix`, `untyped_literal`), ratio 1.8. The text was written knowing the rules that the previous piece tripped on (writing every arm, the order of arms, reference locals, one type per name), so `bmb check` gave 0 language diagnostics and all 33 definitions were proved on the first `bmb verify`. Instead stage0's prover crashed (a name bound by an arm of a `match` whose one side `return`ed stayed alive and collided with a later `for` variable). The one-type-per-name rule makes names like `i`·`k` get reused within a function, and that form was a path stage0 had not tested. The names bound by statement arms were made different per statement (`sl`, `sa`, `sw`, ..): a single `a` would be E0303

Places and settling of let: the `place` family, `try_expr`, `measure_type` (`components`·`reaches_itself`·`struct_cycle`), `settle_lets`, `jump_target`, `field_type_of`, `unknown_local`. 0 diagnostics from `bmb check` from the start. 2 runs of `bmb verify`: among 45 definitions, `settle_lets` alone had two undecided (E0811). That assigning to an element inside a loop over the elements of a `Vec` of `self` keeps the length cannot be solved within the limit: the search and the write were moved into a helper taking `&mut Vec` (`settle_diag`) (the same shape as the earlier friction with loops over fields, workaround). stage0's tuple return `(TypeKind, bool)` is the struct `Place`, and `try_variants`, an `Option<(&str, &str)>`, is a `u8` (0·1·2). In the traversal of `settle_lets`, where a closure read the tables, the visitor `Uses` only gathers positions (`Fact`·`CallUse`) and the tables are read after the traversal: a visitor cannot borrow the tables of `self`. Friction of the editing tool: the normal form writes long bodies on one line and the indentation of closing braces differs by depth, so edits that locate a place by a text fragment cut the wrong place three times (the check pointed it out at once). The right way is the tool that replaces whole definitions (the `bmb` write tool)

`match`·variants·struct literals: `variant_value`, `builtin_variant`, `match_expr` (+`match_variants`·`arm_variant`·`arm_binds`·`match_cover`·`wildcard_arms`·`match_arm`), `struct_lit` (+`expected_args`·`check_slots`·`instance`), the `mentions` family. 53 definitions. 5 diagnostics from `bmb check` on the first run (four E0303: a generated arm name with two types, one E0414: a value moved on only one path), 0 on the second. `bmb verify` proved everything on the first run (0 failures). Forms the surface changed: there is no slice `&segs[..n - 1]`, so the head is made as a copy (`head`). A `Vec<(&Expr, TypeKind)>` cannot be kept, so `check_slots` refers to values by rank (`Slot.at`) and takes the argument list and the field list together, choosing with `by_field`. Tuple returns are structs (`VariantAt`, `Variants`), and arm guards (`Some(t) if ..`) are predicate functions and `if`. stage0's single function `match_expr` (260 lines) was split into four to make the proof units smaller. Editing: new definitions were inserted after anchors that match a whole line (`mod body {`, `    impl Body {`) and the normal form put them in place. 0 wrong cuts

Operations and literals: `binary` (split in three: `binary`, which looks at the operands, `binary_types` for different types, `binary_same` for the same type), `shift`, `int_lit`, `f64_from`, `bit_vector_terms`, `const_ref`, `literal_elem`, `recursive_with_vec`, `text_operand`. 35 definitions. 0 diagnostics from `bmb check`, `bmb verify` proved everything on the first run. Forms the surface changed: stage0's `u128` literal values and `i128` bounds are compared through `wide::U128` and `consts::Num` (sign and magnitude). The `match` with overlapping guards (the 15 arms of `bit_vector_terms`) is unfolded into an `if` per arm with the result held as a number (`what: u8`): arms that build text and arms that recurse are mixed in one `match`, which is hard to return as a value. The recursion measure goes down by `f - 1` per piece: there are only three layers for functions calling each other at the same depth (3f, 3f+1, 3f+2), so a place that needs a fourth layer spends one depth

Expression arms: `expr`, `expr_inner`, the 23 per-arm checks, `collect_triggers`, `first_index_on`, `settled`. 68 definitions. 0 diagnostics from `bmb check`. 2 runs of `bmb verify`: `call_expr` and `path_expr` had three undecided (E0811, the range of an index). The prover does not know that the length is 2 (or at least 1) when `builtin_path(p)` or `vec_builtin(p)` is true: the body of a predicate function is not visible to the caller. The length condition was written alongside in the `if` (the meaning is the same). The dispatch of calls (`call_expr`), which stage0's `match` chose with 23 guards, is a chain of `if`s, and the arms of `expr_inner` are one method each: when one definition grows, the proof slows down. Porting found a defect in stage0 (`u32::from()` reads `args[0]` without checking the length). In BMB that index carries a proof obligation, so the same text cannot be written

Built-in calls and built-in methods: `box_new`, `vec_call`, `mem_call`, `vec_method`, `f64_method`, `copy_within`, `clone_method`. 20 definitions. 0 diagnostics from `bmb check`, `bmb verify` proved everything on the first run. Forms the surface changed: stage0's `Option<&'static str>` (a reason text that is or is not there) is a `String` where empty text means none (`clone_blocked`, `vec_missing`). A table that picked a tuple by name, like `match m { "push" => (1, true, Unit), .. }`, assigns to three variables in a chain of `if`s. The closure `place_ty` (called twice, capturing `self` and `cx`) is the method `mem_place`

Method calls: `method`, `method_target`, `bind_method`, `int_method`, `shared_receiver`, `unknown_method`, `not_a_method`, `method_call`. 22 definitions. 2 first diagnostics from `bmb check` (E0303: `t` has two types in one function, E0504: calling the exec function `Table::len` in a loop invariant — the length is read into a `let` first), `bmb verify` proved everything on the first run. Forms the surface changed: stage0's `Option<Option<MethodTarget>>` is the enum `Found` with three variants. The closure `own` (two kinds) that tested the receiver's type is `owns(t, owner, by_self)`, and so a single method `bind_method` binds both the methods of a type's impl and of a trait. What looped over a `BTreeMap` and tested with `strip_prefix` splits the table's keys into segments and compares them. `sort` + `dedup` is `sorted_set`. `m.starts_with("checked_")` is `checked_arith`, which lists the names

Text (`check/text.rs`): `text_arg`, `text_call`, `text_method`, `char_method`, `as_bytes_arg`. 15 definitions. 0 first diagnostics from `bmb check`, `bmb verify` proved everything on the first run. Forms the surface changed: the chain of guarded `match` arms (`Method { .. } if name == "as_str"`, `_ if str_slice_of(a).is_some()`) is a `match` with an early `return` for each resolving function that returns `Option` (`as_str_of`, `slice_of`, `ref_var`). The three nested `let .. else` of `&s[a..b]` are three functions (`slice_of`·`slice_index`·`range_of`). A place that reads `args[0]` writes `args.len() > 0` again even after comparing the argument count (the argument count does not follow from the comparison of the name's text)

Conversions and reference arguments: `conversion`, `ref_arg`, `slice_of_vec`, `e0218`, `data_ref_arg`, `sub_slice_arg`. 13 definitions. 2 first diagnostics from `bmb check` (both E0303: one name with two types in one function), `bmb verify` proved everything on the first run. Forms the surface changed: stage0's `Option<Option<String>>` (`slice_of_vec`) is the struct `VecSlice { about, root }`. `let (var, explicit_ref, am) = match .. { an early return in every arm }`, which binds a tuple, is split into a `match` that assigns to two variables and a `match` that resolves the name. The closure `vec_var` is a free function. The alias diagnostics `self.diags.aliases` are the field `aliases` of `Body`

Calls and type arguments: `call`, `call_arg`, `written_targs`, `targs_fix`, `arg_peek`, `place_peek`, `dispatch`, `reads_only`. 31 definitions. 8 first diagnostics from `bmb check` (four E0303: two types for one name, two E0414: a value moved on only one path, E0103: the reserved word `proof` used as a variable name and one consequence of it). 2 failures on the first run of `bmb verify`, both the solver's resource limit: `call` (357 lines of stage0 ported as one function, 102 obligations, z3 ended on memory) was solved by splitting it into `call_kind`·`call_arg`·`call_deferred`·`call_bound`·`call_record`·`alias_check`, and in `call_arg` the cause was calling a `&mut self` method on the right of `&&` (`.. && !self.deref_fix(..)`) (solved by moving the call out of the condition). Forms the surface changed: the nine arms of the `match` on the tuple `(mode, sig.kind)` are a chain of `if`s. `continue` inside the loop is an early `return` of a method that handles one argument. Slice patterns (`[]`, `[t]`, `[t, ..]`) are comparisons of a counted number. `BTreeMap<String, TypeKind>` is `types::Subst` and `sub_put`

Global checks: `check_recursion`, `trait_cycles`, `check_main`, `sccs_with_cycles`, `defs_of`. 29 definitions. 7 first diagnostics from `bmb check` (three E0606: the `pure` declaration of functions calling `Table::find`, two E0410: reading a field of a `&mut` receiver as an argument, as in `t.index.insert(v, t.next)`, two E0414). `bmb verify` proved everything on the first run. Forms the surface changed: the local struct and `impl` inside a function (Tarjan's `T`) are the unit's struct `Scc` and the free function `scc_visit`. What visited neighbours in `BTreeSet` order sorts with `decls::sorted` on every visit. `while let Some(x) = work.pop()` is a `while` with fuel to show termination and a method that handles one step (`instance_edges`). The `sort` of `Vec<Vec<String>>` is the order of the first elements (`by_first`), since the components do not overlap. `type_depth` has an `ensures` that the result does not exceed the fuel, because of the overflow obligation

Driver·tables·comparison: `check_program`, `check_resolved`, `ConstTrees` (stage0 `consts::literal_tree`), `Methodize`, `may_untrusted`, `push_tables`·`check` of `lib`. 24 definitions. 6 first diagnostics from `bmb check` (E0303, four E0401: the `i` of `for i in 0..10` is `i64` and mixes with `usize`, E0414). 3 failures on the first run of `bmb verify` (overflow·postcondition of `key_part` and `last_of`, the loop invariant of `may_untrusted`: that the length of a `Vec` passed as `&mut` does not shrink cannot be known after the call, so what is to be added was gathered separately). In the first comparison of output with stage0 (`dump types` of the 936 tracked `.bmb` files) 715 were the same and stage1 crashed on 195: a stage0 defect (a double free after a partial move out of a value bound by an arm). After the fix the remaining differences were two omissions of earlier pieces: resolving `#[uses(<T as Tr>::m)]` (`decls::uses_target`), and the place where the constant check removes the evaluator's diagnostics (in stage0 the checker runs over the diagnostic list of the earlier stages). The proof could not see these two (behaviour without a spec). Forms the surface changed: `literal_tree`, which took three closures (`fresh`, `id`, `segs`) and two `&mut`s, is a method of `ConstTrees`, a struct holding the state (passing `&self.adts` and `&mut self.types` in one call is E0410). `loop { .. return .. }` is a `while` with fuel. `rsplit_once` is `last_of`, which finds the position, and `lexer::cut`

`moves` (`selfhost/moves.bmb`): 1,164 lines of stage0 `moves.rs` became 1,491 lines, 66 definitions. 9 first diagnostics from `bmb check` (two E0103: the reserved word `spec` used as a field name, six E0414: values put into a table only inside a condition, one E0303). 2 failures on the first run of `bmb verify`: `moves::jump` (the index range of a loop, solved by looping over a copy of the state), and the untouched `body::Body::expr_inner` went over the solver limit (when `Body` gained one field, the type invariant obligation at the end of the thirty-five-arm `match` went from 73% to 102% of the 5 million limit). Holding the drop places inside `Needs` instead of a new field of `Body` still went over, so `expr_inner` was split into two methods by expression kind (`expr_early`·`expr_late`) (42% and 50% of the limit). Forms the surface changed: the struct `Mv<'a>` holding references is split into `Mv`, which holds values, and the read-only `Env`, and the table of expression types and the table of data types are lent out with `std::mem::replace` and taken back (not copied). `BTreeMap<String, St>` is two `Vec`s kept in name order (`State`): keys must be removable, so `table::Table` could not be used. `enum St` and `Option<St>` are `u8` 0·1·2. A guarded arm (`Field { .. } if a local field`) is a `match` on the `Option` returned by `local_field`. 0 differences in the first comparison with stage0

`check::methodize` (`selfhost/methodize.bmb`): about 190 lines of stage0 became 16 definitions. What the closure `&mut |e| {..}` captured (the unit's path, the position of the definition, the calls to keep, the table of rewritten calls) are fields of the visitor struct `Rewrite`: the checker's tables cannot be held by reference either, so a copy is held on every iteration. `loop` is a `while` with a step limit (`fuel`) (it runs only while the kept set grows, but that could not be used as the measure). The arguments that were moved with `std::mem::take(args)` are copies. The two guarded arms (`Ref { expr, .. } if by_ref`, `k if own(k)`) are `match`es of thirty-five·seventeen arms and an `Option`. 5 first diagnostics from `bmb check` (E0303, E0410: `self.conv.insert(.., self.fk.clone())`, two E0414, E0413: taking out of a box with `*x.clone()`); `bmb verify` passed entirely on the first run (1,501). 0 differences in the first comparison with stage0

This row is not closed: it has only what the encoder derives from the tables before it reads a body (the view of slices, the instances of generic spec fns, sorts, datatype declarations, text signatures, default contexts) and compares `dump smt-decls`. The ratio comes out low because the ported part is measured against all of C6. The 85 definitions (1,151 obligations) were all proved on the first run of `bmb verify`

The tables of the earlier components are left as they are: a new struct `encode_decls::Prepared` wraps the view with the instances, the instance types, the text signatures and the contexts, so the proofs of code generation are not keyed again

The closures of the traversal (`each_expr` taking `&mut dyn FnMut`) became a walk that gathers nodes into a `Vec` and a visitor struct for calls; a substitution map is `types::Subst` kept in name order; maps keyed by position are `table::Table` under `body::span_key`: left as is

Porting found a defect in stage0: the walk that finds the instances of generic spec fns did not enter the two ends of a range, so a generic call written there whose contract names a generic spec fn made `bmb verify` halt. stage0 was fixed and the port followed in the same commit (`tests/verify/pass/range_instances.bmb`, `tests/port/smt/range.txt`)

`context_of` cuts a generic path at the first `<` after the last `::`, so a type argument that itself has a path would not find its context. It has no effect today because the context of a spec fn is always empty: copied as is

The second piece (`encode_terms.bmb`, compared by the case `smt-terms`) has the values of expressions and the term builders that read no encoder state. The functions are not reached by a dump of a program, so two test programs call each over a grid of arguments written out in both (`tests/port/smt_terms_ref.rs`, an example of the compiler's crate, and `tests/port/smt_terms.bmb`); stage0 only made the builders public. `gate_runs` counts the two runs of this piece: on the first, 6 of its 139 definitions (builders and grid together) failed (the width of an integer type had no contract, so `w - 1` and `% w` fell to E0803·E0804, the friction code generation's `bit_method` met; a `for` starting at a constant or at an earlier length had no invariant on entry; one of them, a loop from the old length of a list that a callee grows, was undecided at the resource limit), on the second all were proved. The outputs of the two sides were byte-identical on the first comparison

There is no integer wider than 64 bits: stage0's `i128` terms (`2^64`, the numerals of a query read back) are a sign and a `wide::U128` (`encode_terms::Int`), written through `wide::push_radix`; a mask `2^k - 1`, a shift amount and an amount modulo the width are read from the low word: left as is

A function value that captures the encoder (`set_at`'s `mk: &mut dyn FnMut`, which is `Enc::mk_struct`) cannot be passed: the two fields it writes (the name counters and the declarations) became a struct `encode_terms::Fresh` that `set_at` takes, with `fresh` and `mk_struct` ported beside it. The encoder's state of the next piece has to hold a `Fresh` for these to be shared: undecided until that piece

Rust's panics on a value of the wrong shape (`Val::s` of an array, `store_val` of two shapes) have no counterpart: the port returns a fixed value there (empty text, the unit value, the template as it is) and the summaries say the encoder passes none. The iterator of leaf terms (`&mut impl Iterator`) is a slice and a position; enum variants with named fields (`Val::A { elems, len }`) are positional (E0233); text slices returned by the readers (`first_term`, `select_app`) are copies cut at byte positions with the run-time boundary check of `lexer::cut`: left as is

This row is not closed: it has only the lowered tables, type layout and the code generation of scalar programs, and compares `dump lowered`·`dump layout` and `emit-llvm --all-checks` on the allow list. What was ported is `lower` of stage0's `check/text.rs` and `Tables::lowered`·`struct_fields`·`enum_variants`·`value_ty` of `verify.rs` (files of C4·C6), so the ratio is not measured against C8. `gate_runs` is the number of `bmb verify` runs of the whole port (the first five pieces once each, all proved on the first run; the sixth twice: on the first run `w - 1` of `bit_method` fell to E0803; the seventh once)

There is no way to hold constant IR text (`include_str!`·long text in a `const`): `scripts/codegen_text.py` makes `selfhost/codegen_text.bmb` from stage0's `bmb dump runtime` and the gate checks its freshness: workaround, for the same reason as `std_units`
`Gen` cannot have a reference to the tables as a field (references are second-class), so the tables (`&lowered::Tables`, `&body::Checked`) are passed as parameters to every method: left as is

Within one function one name has one type (E0303), so the binding names of the 35-arm `expr` were made different per arm (`uop`·`ux`, `bop`·`lhs`·`rhs`, `ifx`): the third time for the same friction. Left as is, the language's choice, but the cost grows in a large `match`

The only ways to join text are `push_str` and `cat2`~`cat7` with a fixed number of arguments (there is no `format!`): every time a line of IR is built, the function matching the number of pieces is picked and empty text is put in the leftover positions. The 370 `format!` places of stage0 are ported this way: left as is; by the decision criterion (a language agents want to write) it is a candidate to fix (a standard function taking a list of text pieces, or interpolation)

`old` is a reserved word and cannot be used as a binding name (E0103 `expected binding or `_``): the diagnostic does not say it is a reserved word. The name was changed (`prev`): workaround, the diagnostic's text is a candidate to fix

The layout arithmetic on `u64` (`size.div_ceil(a) * a + s`) raises overflow obligations: it is written with wrapping operations like stage0's release build (`wrapping_add`·`wrapping_mul`·`wrapping_sub`) and division by zero is blocked by an arm (`round_up`): left as is
There are no wildcard arms, so the 17 arms of `TypeKind` are written in three more places (`lower_in`·`struct_fields`·`enum_variants`): left as is, the language's choice (ADR-0026)
Within one function one name has one type (E0303): the two arms of a `match` cannot bind the same name with different types, so the names were split (`fs`·`sf`, `vs`·`ev`): left as is
